[EXPERIMENTAL - Item box at the Quest Supply Box (X + Y) - MH3U EUR v32 - by jM5557]
{On a quest, open the blue supply box as usual, then press X + Y: the box shows your item box from home, 40 slots per page (empty pages are skipped). Take items like supplies. X + Y again: next page; after the last page it goes back to the quest supplies. Stacks are cut down to what your pouch can hold; the rest stays in the item box. What you take is removed from your item box. Taking only (the supply box has no way to put items in). Offline only. Switch back to the supplies before turning this off. Items are lost if you abandon quest.}
